mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling weakening supply chains, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high RSAFS value (> 500,000), indicating strong real estate activity, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising FEDFUNDS and a low CPIAUCSL (< 250) creates a unique monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances with rising FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold UNRATE (< 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a high HOUST value (> 1200) indicates strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of post-shock recovery instances with high HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
